Fields.Name: Parent Index
Fields.Description: Index of this node's parent, or -1 for none.

Fields.Name: First Child Index
Fields.Description: Index of this node's first child, or -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Next Sibling Index
Fields.Description: Index of the next child of this node's parent, or -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Previous Sibling Index
Fields.Description: Index of the previous child of this node's parent, or -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Rotation
Fields.Description: Rotation of this bone; euler radians in XZY order.

Fields.Name: Bounding Box: Minimum Extent
Fields.Description: Minimum extent of the vertices weighted to this bone.

Fields.Name: Bounding Box: Maximum Extent
Fields.Description: Maximum extent of the vertices weighted to this bone.

Fields.Name: Flags
Fields.Description: A set of flags denoting the properties of a node.
